summary: Confirmed s1_centroid_similarity_chatgpt_vs_web_search, s1_mst_distance_chatgpt_vs_web_search, s1_pairwise_similarity_chatgpt_vs_web_search, s1_unique_fraction_075_chatgpt_vs_web_search, s1_unique_fraction_080_chatgpt_vs_web_search, and s1_unique_fraction_085_chatgpt_vs_web_search. Read the complete main-paper markdown, including the Reporting Summary, and the complete supplement markdown. Extracted the cited supplement PDF pages 2-3 and recovered Supplementary Table 1 with pymupdf.find_tables(); also checked main PDF pages 1-3 and 5. Every recorded arm level, signed effect, confidence limit, confidence level, test statistic, degree of freedom, p-value, and participant count matches its Study 1 row. The analysis includes 103 ChatGPT-assisted and 130 Web-search-assisted participants, with the printed total of 233. All requested codes are consistent with the outcomes, arms, analysis units, timing, and available preregistration evidence. Similarity coefficients retain the printed control-minus-treatment direction; unique-idea arm levels retain percent units while risk differences retain proportion units. Independently verified se_basis=participant using the original Experiment 1 methods (c010 PDF page 6, printed page 1911), D:/projects/ai-skill-atlas/creativity-data/osf-zf3s2/analysis.ipynb cells 0-1, 3, 7, and 9, and its exp_1 input CSVs. The 103 chatbot and 130 control input entries match all distinct same-arm participants in Exp1.main.cleaned.csv one-to-one after whitespace normalization and correction of the documented encoding artifacts. The notebook embeds whole responses without splitting multiple ideas, averages pairwise similarities per response before OLS, uses response counts in the proportions test, and permutes whole response embeddings for MST inference. The notebook was read without executing its analyses. The supplement_changes audit found no replacement or removal of an existing numerical value. Main-text numerical records remain consistent with the main PDF: the sprinkler counts on page 1 and the human-only unique-idea percentage on page 2 are preserved. No problems found in the six requested estimates.
